notes: The bench judge's expected-verdict roster (tools/benchjudge --roster): membership by cell name, the board-side sibling of the gate's expected-failure test roster. Every cell is judged at the ceiling its bench sidecar declares (general 1.3, text 1.7; tools/benchjudge states both derivations) — this file carries expectations only and can never select a ceiling. `red` cells must be judged and read red at their own ceiling: the one member is the permanent schoolbook display tripwire (`display_schoolbook/hugeleaf`, a text-ceiling cell timing the known-quadratic conversion class kept in bench code — green means the tripwire went dark). Every other cell, the pinned subset's designed diagonal and the BOARD_RED_BENCH_RIDERS alike, must fit under its own ceiling: the board's standing counter reds (owned display/tick/min_ticks constants, the fold marginals, the capacity-phase projection cells) keep their time legs judged green — a constant-factor red is not a time-exponent red. `boundary` cells fit within the fit-noise band of their own ceiling (fit_noise_band in tools/benchjudge states the derivation) and may read either verdict; the set is empty at this tip. The sampling pin lists both modes because these are exponent-class expectations, which hold under quick and record sampling alike (record-mode wide-pair exponents measured 1.464/2.001, 2026-07-24); the profile and the scale pair stay singly pinned. Membership is pinned by crates/before/tests/bench_judge_roster.rs.
